lead.titleZh: PT 依从临床指南的障碍与促进因素
lead.titleEn: Barriers and Facilitators to PT Guideline Adherence
lead.paragraphZh: 今天关注骨科与肌骨领域，一项加拿大观察研究探讨了非特异性腰痛临床实践指南依从性的环境障碍与促进因素。另一项运动康复研究关联了万古霉素浸泡的股四头肌移植物与ACL重建术后早期吸收。
lead.paragraphEn: Today's focus is on the musculoskeletal domain, with a Canadian observational study exploring environmental barriers and facilitators to non-specific low back pain clinical practice guideline adherence. Another sports rehabilitation study links vancomycin-soaked quadriceps grafts to early resorption post-ACLR.

items.title: A qualitative inquiry into the environmental barriers and facilitators to non-specific low back pain clinical practice guideline adherence among Canadian physiotherapists.
items.summary: A qualitative inquiry explored environmental barriers and facilitators influencing Canadian physiotherapists' adherence to non-specific low back pain clinical practice guidelines, identifying key factors across public and private sectors using the Theoretical Domains Framework and Ecological Systems Theory.
items.curatedReason: 本研究揭示了加拿大物理治疗师在非特异性腰痛临床实践指南依从性方面面临的环境障碍和促进因素。了解这些因素有助于优化指南实施策略，提升你在腰痛管理中的临床依从性。
items.titleZh: 加拿大物理治疗师非特异性腰痛临床实践指南依从性的环境障碍与促进因素：一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究探讨了影响加拿大物理治疗师依从非特异性腰痛临床实践指南的环境障碍和促进因素，通过理论领域框架和生态系统理论识别了公共和私营部门的关键因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study reveals environmental barriers and facilitators to non-specific low back pain clinical practice guideline adherence among Canadian physiotherapists. Understanding these factors can help optimize guideline implementation strategies and improve your clinical adherence in LBP management.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，其发现的普遍性和外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This is a qualitative study, and the generalizability and external validity of its findings are limited.

items.title: Outcome measures used in studies of vestibular rehabilitation after stroke: a scoping review.
items.summary: A scoping review identified and mapped outcome measures used in studies evaluating vestibular rehabilitation for adults with stroke, systematically searching MEDLINE, Embase, and PEDro to categorize and rank the frequency of their use.
items.curatedReason: 这份范围综述清晰展现了卒中后前庭康复研究中，我们最常用的评估工具是什么。在你设计临床路径或研究方案时，优先考虑这些被广泛接受的结局指标，能更好地与现有证据对话。
items.titleZh: 卒中后前庭康复研究中使用的结局测量：一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项范围综述识别并梳理了卒中成人前庭康复研究中使用的结局测量指标，系统搜索了MEDLINE、Embase和PEDro数据库以进行分类和频率排序。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review clearly outlines the most frequently used outcome measures in post-stroke vestibular rehabilitation research. When designing your clinical pathways or research protocols, prioritizing these widely accepted measures will allow for better engagement with existing evidence.
items.limitation: 范围综述的性质限制了其对结局测量工具有效性或质量的深入评估。
items.limitationEn: The nature of a scoping review limits its ability to deeply assess the validity or quality of outcome measurement tools.

items.title: Vancomycin-Soaked Quadriceps Grafts Linked to Early Resorption in ACLR: study
items.summary: A study suggests that vancomycin-soaked quadriceps grafts are linked to early resorption following anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction (ACLR).
items.curatedReason: 这项研究指出万古霉素浸泡的股四头肌移植物与ACL重建术后早期吸收有关。这直接影响您在评估和管理ACL重建术后患者时，对移植物稳定性和并发症的预期和监测，尤其是在有药物浸泡史的病例中。
items.titleZh: 研究：万古霉素浸泡的股四头肌移植物与ACL重建术后早期吸收相关
items.summaryZh: 一项研究提示，万古霉素浸泡的股四头肌移植物与前交叉韧带重建术后的早期吸收有关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study indicates a link between vancomycin-soaked quadriceps grafts and early resorption after ACLR. This directly impacts your expectations and monitoring of graft stability and complications when evaluating and managing post-ACLR patients, especially those with a history of soaked grafts.
items.limitation: 新闻报道未提供原始研究的具体细节（如样本量、研究设计），因此结论需谨慎对待。
items.limitationEn: The news report does not provide specific details of the original study (e.g., sample size, study design), so conclusions should be treated with caution.

items.title: Repeated sprint performance and fatigue responses across different movement patterns in amateur soccer players
items.summary: A study investigated repeated sprint performance and fatigue responses across various movement patterns in amateur soccer players.
items.curatedReason: 这项观察研究提示，业余足球运动员在不同运动模式下的重复冲刺表现和疲劳反应有差异。你在设计训练方案时，要考虑这些模式差异，但本研究无法告诉你如何优化。
items.titleZh: 业余足球运动员在不同运动模式下的重复冲刺表现和疲劳反应
items.summaryZh: 一项研究考察了业余足球运动员在不同运动模式下的重复冲刺表现和疲劳反应。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study suggests amateur soccer players show varied repeated sprint performance and fatigue responses across different movement patterns. When designing training, consider these pattern differences, but this study doesn't tell you how to optimize.
items.limitation: 研究对象仅限于业余足球运动员，结果在专业运动员中可能存在差异。
items.limitationEn: The study was limited to amateur soccer players; results may differ for professional athletes.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Federated learning for privacy-preserving collaborative health risk classification using wearable sensor data: validation study with elite football training load monitoring - BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation
items.summary: A validation study demonstrated federated learning's ability to classify health risks using wearable sensor data from elite football players while preserving privacy.
items.curatedReason: 这项验证研究展示了联邦学习在保护精英足球运动员可穿戴传感器数据隐私的同时，进行健康风险分类的潜力。这有助于您在应用技术监控高水平运动员训练负荷时，平衡数据利用与隐私保护的需求。
items.titleZh: 联邦学习在精英足球训练负荷监测中应用于隐私保护协作健康风险分类的验证研究
items.summaryZh: 一项验证研究表明，联邦学习能够在使用可穿戴传感器数据监测精英足球运动员训练负荷时，在保护隐私的前提下进行健康风险分类。
items.curatedReasonEn: This validation study demonstrates the potential of federated learning for privacy-preserving health risk classification using wearable sensor data in elite football players. This helps you balance data utilization with privacy protection when applying technology to monitor training loads in high-level athletes.
items.limitation: 研究的重点在于技术验证，并未直接评估其对临床决策或康复干预的实际影响。
items.limitationEn: The study focuses on technical validation and does not directly assess its practical impact on clinical decision-making or rehabilitation interventions.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Trump Administration Announces $144 million to Improve Mental Health, Substance Abuse, Emergency and Maternal Care and Expand the Healthcare Workforce in Alabama
items.summary: The Trump Administration announced a $144 million allocation to enhance mental health, substance abuse, emergency, and maternal care, and expand the healthcare workforce in Alabama.
items.curatedReason: 美国特朗普政府宣布拨款1.44亿美元用于改善阿拉巴马州的心理健康、药物滥用、急诊和孕产妇护理，并扩大医疗保健劳动力。这笔资金可能影响当地PT的转诊网络和与其他医疗专业人员的协作。
items.titleZh: 特朗普政府宣布拨款1.44亿美元改善阿拉巴马州医疗健康服务并扩大医护队伍
items.summaryZh: 特朗普政府宣布拨款1.44亿美元，用于改善阿拉巴马州的心理健康、药物滥用、急诊和孕产妇护理，并扩大医疗保健劳动力。
items.curatedReasonEn: The Trump Administration announced $144 million to improve mental health, substance abuse, emergency, and maternal care, and expand the healthcare workforce in Alabama. This funding could impact local PT referral networks and collaboration with other healthcare professionals.
